_meta.description: Versioned rule contract for AOP 2027 One Portfolio Navigator. Every release must carry a matching copy of this file. A challenge on any scoring, stage or allocation rule cites this document as the authoritative answer.
_meta.status: DRAFT — awaiting ExCo sign-off before publication

classificationRules.P1_LFR: Programme has a non-blank LFR Name or LFR Year (isLfrRecord), OR Overall AOP Decision contains 'must-do', OR item is one of: EW-11, EW-65, EW-71 (CCB-LFR by name), OR programme name matches CCB_LFR_NAMES set
classificationRules.P3_Sustain: newCarry is 'change & sustain', OR category normalised to one of: 'continuous improvement', 'continous improvement', 'continuous improvement (ci)', 'upgrades & enhancements'
classificationRules.P4_Value: All remaining records not classified above
classificationRules.P5_ITSimp: Stage 4 in solver; only active when itsimpMode toggle is ON in settings. Identification: category contains 'decomm' or 'replatform'

itSimpToggle.default: OFF for optimal, protect, capacity; ON for evidence (Balanced Portfolio) and mustdo
itSimpToggle.onBehavior: IT Simplification programmes promoted to stage 4 and funded from a separate ring-fenced envelope before Value (P4) competition
itSimpToggle.offBehavior: IT Simplification programmes remain at P4 (Value) with stage demand shown as zero

stages.recordedDecisionRef: validation/run_cycle.py comment preceding approved_names — 29 September 2026 four-stage change. IT Simplification added as optional P5 in subsequent release history.

durationStates.blank_source: Source cell null or whitespace-only → effectiveDuration = 3 years; benefitDurationAssumed = true (labelled in UI)
durationStates.valid_positive: Source parsed to a positive number or 'N years' text → use as-is
durationStates.invalid: Source is 0, negative, or unparseable text → effectiveDuration = null; annual benefit and BCR unavailable (displayed as 'Invalid')

annualisationAndDuration.zeroBenefit: Submitted zero (numeric 0) is preserved as zero. With valid duration and positive request: annualBenefit = 0, BCR = 0, benefit tier = 1 (not qualitative fallback). benefitClass = 'zero'.
annualisationAndDuration.missingBenefit: Source cell null/blank → annualBenefit = null, BCR unavailable, qualitative fallback applies
annualisationAndDuration.recordedDecisionRef: Memory/AOP2027-Demand-Context.md, Current refresh v5.9.5 — annualisation introduced; outputs/refresh-v5.9.5-20261005/README-v5.9.5.txt — blank duration defaults to three years; explicit invalid duration remains invalid

scoring.componentFormula: score = sum(raw_i / rawMax_i × weight_i) for i in 0..4

bcrTiers.description: Annual BCR (= annualBenefit / requestedCost); raw points out of 5
bcrTiers.suppressionRule: When benefitMode is 'hard': soft-benefit programmes have ratio suppressed to null (enters qualitative path). When 'soft': hard-benefit programmes suppressed. Applies only at stage 1–4.

decisionBandPoints.note: Uninterpretable source value triggers a hold; programme excluded from funding until resolved

paybackTiers.description: Payback period in years; raw points out of 10

qualitativeFallback.description: Used when BCR ratio is null (missing benefit or suppressed). Revenue/productivity text in benefit details field → 0 pts. Otherwise qualitativeBenefit() assigns 0–4 pts based on Impact/Problem/Scope evidence.
qualitativeFallback.zeroBenefitOverride: Explicit zero benefit bypasses qualitative fallback entirely; goes directly to BCR tier (ratio = 0 → tier 1 = 1 raw point)

lfrLever.note: 28M LFR envelope; 26M confirmed-opt-in cap after ExCo opt-outs applied

balancedTargets.regionPriority: IR (all items) first, then GRC, then NAR LFR via Phase 0c3 (EW-28)
balancedTargets.note: Bu-87 NAR Commercial Excellence excluded from region anchor — competes on BU merit

PMI_NDA.description: PMI and NDA programmes (type field = 'PMI' in source) are funded automatically on top of the base AOP envelope. They are not included in the 100 M€ budget competition.
PMI_NDA.overrideOrder: Manual exclusion (choice='exclude') is checked first and zeroes final funding. Manual partial scope (choice='include' with amount) is applied next. Default auto-full-fund runs only when no override exists.

onTopRules.carryConfirmed: Carry-over items are 'confirmed' when: stage=1 AND isBaselinedCarry AND priority is 'must do' or 'must have'. Confirmed carry items receive automatic baseline funding before merit competition.

lfrExcoDecisions.source: LFR_EXCO_DECISIONS embedded in engine — each ExCo member's opt-in/opt-out decision for individual LFR programmes

manualOverrideOrder.description: Order of precedence when manual decisions are applied in solve()
steps: 1. PMI branch: check overrides[id].choice first — 'exclude' zeroes final before auto-fund runs
2. Phase 0c2: protect EW-11, EW-65, EW-71, EW-28 from Phase 1 defunding
3. Phase 0c3: force-fund EW-28 (NAR LFR) if unfunded
4. Phase 0d: force-fund ISC up to _iscTarget floor (evidence/mustdo only)
5. Phase 0e: force-fund STO up to _stoTarget floor (evidence/mustdo only)
6. Phase 0f: force-fund IR then GRC to fill region floor (evidence/mustdo only)
7. Phase 1: cap F&R (40M), BU-led (60M), regions (5M) — defund lowest-merit non-protected items
8. Non-PMI overrides (include/exclude/partial) applied to main solver rows
9. LFR opt-out overrides applied as programme-level excludes before main solve
manualOverrideOrder.protectedItems: Items force-funded via bpFundForced() receive _protected=true and cannot be defunded by Phase 1 cap enforcement
